headline: Upheaval in the EU debt map: Belgium borrows like Greece, but at what cost for Greeks?
summary: Greece recorded a 2025 budget surplus of 1.7% of GDP, and its debt fell by more than nine percentage points of GDP within a year. Debt remains the highest in the EU.
why: Budget balance and debt-to-GDP ratios drive sovereign credit ratings and bond yields, which matter for investors in euro-area government debt.
